title: Component Classes Content, Version 1
description: The content of the role histogram of a nemar.ic-classes view: the independent components of one decomposition counted by the class each is most likely to be (its dominant class), with the variance the components of each class account for. It is a histogram content binned by category (content.nemar.histogram.v1), so a renderer that draws the view by its base nemar.histogram reads categories and counts; this preset adds the classifier (with ICLabel, the categories are exactly its seven classes in its order), summed_variance_pct and n_components. docs/views/presets.md gives the rules JSON Schema cannot state: one summed_variance_pct per category, and counts that sum to n_components.

categories.description: ICLabel's seven classes, in ICLabel's order and spelling.

classifier.description: ICLabel is spelled as ICLabel spells it, so its categories cannot be left open by a change of case.

The classifier that gave each component's class probabilities, by name. No character of it is a format character (Unicode category Cf, such as a zero-width space or joiner), and it neither begins nor ends with white space; inside it, the only white space is the space U+0020. The pattern spells both sets out as one class, so Python's re and JavaScript's RegExp with the u flag read it alike. ICLabel fixes the categories; any other name leaves them open.

categories.description: The classes, in the classifier's order (for ICLabel: Brain, Muscle, Eye, Heart, Line Noise, Channel Noise, Other).

counts.description: For each class, the number of components whose most probable class it is; each component is counted once.

summed_variance_pct.description: For each class, in category order, the sum of the variance_pct of the components counted in it: the percent of the data's variance each component accounts for on its own (EEGLAB's pvaf), which is not bounded to 0 to 100 and does not sum to 100 across components.

n_components.description: The number of components of the decomposition; the counts sum to it.
